correctness.rationale: For the precisely defined stationary reset process with θ_N=m_N/N→θ>0, conditional on backward Poisson gaps E_j the latest reset index of one label has weights θ_N q_N^k. Finite-label hypergeometric inclusion indicators converge jointly to independent Bernoulli θ marks and tails are uniformly geometric, establishing random weak empirical-measure convergence to μθ=Σ θq^kγ_{T_k}. Pair ages generator gives E[A_iA_j]=2/(r²θ_N h_{2,N}) and h_{2,N}=θ_N(2−θ_N)+θ_N(1−θ_N)/(N−1); Gaussian fourth moments plus conditional-mean projection yield 0≤E[(Q_N−2DS_N)²]≤6(2D)²/(r²Nθ_N²). Independent rational recomputation found normalized projection errors 64/15 for (N,m)=(4,2), 1348/351 for (8,3), 471/760 for (15,10), each within bound; direct finite mark counts checked. Independence of E_j proves q-product Laplace, κ_k, and strong right-tail equivalent via exp moment of j≥1 remainder. This is a genuine infinite conditional convergence proof plus finite corroboration; q=0 works as the single exponential term.
